<thought>From the isotopic pattern, the strong M‑2 peak (~77 % of the base) matches the natural 35Cl/37Cl ratio, indicating chlorine. The noticeable M+1 peak (~10 % of the base) corresponds to the ~1 % per carbon 13C contribution, implying the presence of carbon. No other element shows a characteristic pattern strong enough to be definitive. Therefore the elements that can be definitively identified are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
